# Distribution binaries

Stable download URLs (no versions in names, always the latest published build):

- macOS: `dist/macos/KidsPiggyBank-macos.dmg`
- iOS: `dist/ios/KidsPiggyBank-ios.ipa` (appears once a signed build exists)
- `dist/manifest.json` — machine-readable tags, sizes, and checksums consumed
  by the Firebase predeploy step of the main repository.

Binaries are published here (public repo) because the main codebase lives in
a private repository whose release assets are not visible to guests.
